# Field

**`Field`** The bordered box shared by `TextField`, `SelectField` and `Combobox`: border, focus ring, error state. Put an `<input>` (with a placeholder) or `<select>` and then a `<label>` inside it.

**`fieldChevronClass`** Class for a chevron placed inside a `Field` holding a select.

## Files

To use this on its own, copy this folder:

- `Field.module.css`
- `Field.tsx`

It also needs:

- [`src/primitives/FieldError`](../FieldError)
- [`src/utils.ts`](../../utils.ts)

Everything expects a [`Theme`](../../theme) somewhere above it, which supplies the colours, corners and timings.
